recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: cpus quietly returning to the llm inference stage
ai labs tangled in an accidental crossfire
marine layer folding san francisco into gray
august dawn at thirteen degrees beneath the haze
agents spun up from a pocket before sunrise

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch glowing build shipments drifting through pre-dawn fog before the deploy window closes — miss too many and the pipeline stalls.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: One deploy window: fill the progress bar before fog swallows the horizon.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fog banks thicken, spawns accelerate, decoy packages appear.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: misty blue-gray pixel dawn with neon cargo trails

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flip inference batches between CPU and GPU lanes before the queue overheats — the chips trade roles mid-round as load shifts.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Keep latency under a sliding threshold for 60 seconds.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Batch sizes swell, thermal throttling flashes red choke zones.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: schematic motherboard with phosphor green traces

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw connection paths between parallel agent nodes on a phone screen — each brain thinks differently, only linked paths unlock the next surgical edit.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Complete a three-agent chain in under 45 seconds to ship one feature.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: More agents spawn at once, paths cannot cross.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper wireframe flowchart with hand-drawn ink

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick incoming device cards into lease tiers before they pile off-screen — upgrade, downgrade, or renew before the billing cycle ends.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Survive one billing cycle without overflow.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: New device categories appear mid-round with tighter time limits.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: glassy iOS-style cards on fog-white backdrop
